findings: Confirmed C21 root cause: confidence-first conversion-only merge selected channel/social runner; merge source lookup required source_set.selected_candidate and failed.
Confirmed contribution_pct-first ordering is appropriate as a conversion-only merge exception, not a general ranking rewrite.
Confirmed merge_contribution_sets should resolve selected candidates by source_set.candidates membership while still fail-fast when absent.

Regression risks: MC03 channel-social/organic conversion merge must be guarded; MC06 low risk because mixed net_gmv is not conversion-only; precision gates depend on retained candidates and should not be broadened.
